MAKER BUG: the tests at LCMP2.cpp:135 and LCMP2.cpp:155 ask whether the six outputs are connected but index the inputs vector with output enum values. The inputs vector holds six entries, so the second block reads past its end. In practice the module decides it has work to do whenever any input jack is patched.
The outputs carry whatever is patched to True and False, so they are left without a family colour; the four logic inputs are gates.
